notes: Well-structured: a message bus whose transcript is the dashboard feed, a brain that always computes the heuristic first and validates any model answer before an instruction is built (it holds no keys; ClaudeBrain's success, bad-JSON, API-error and rejected-answer paths are now unit-tested with an injected client), a planner with best-offer-per-city scoring, nearest-neighbour + 2-opt routing, rest days and venue availability, and a crank limited to the three permissionless instructions with payees taken from the stored account. The orchestrator now subscribes to accept/reject before proposing, takes the live show list from chain state, chunks getMultipleAccountsInfo, batches venue funding, and the fan population scales with city population, so the headline path finally shows in the default demo: the two latest runs booked 8/8 shows on sane 1600-2000 km routes and produced 1 and 2 natural cancellations with every ticket refunded, the rest settled with crew payees; qa/src/checks.ts:151 now requires it. Remaining gaps: negotiation is single-shot and in heuristic mode a venue rejection is structurally impossible (rejected: 0 in every run although docs describe accept/reject), validate() leaves offeredCapacity/minPriceLamports unchecked for type and sign, crew.hired messages duplicate their reasoning text, and the history tour's 4-second deadline will likely cancel before fans buy.
issues: packages/agents/src/venue-agent.ts:143-146 with planner.ts:168-179: the band proposes exactly the venue's askBps, max(minPrice, target) and an available day, so heuristic venues can never reject and there is no counter-offer round; both latest runs show rejected: 0 while docs/05-architecture.md:46 describes accept_show or reject_show

packages/agents/src/venue-agent.ts:101-102: validate() does not check that offeredCapacity is a positive integer or that minPriceLamports is a finite non-negative integer; a bad model answer (string/NaN) propagates to planner.ts:179 and only fails at proposeShow

packages/agents/src/band-agent.ts:237: every crew.hired message for a show carries the same combined reasoning text (transcript ids 229/230 in run 2026-10-08T20-14-51-137Z read identically); emit a per-hire line

packages/agents/src/orchestrator.ts:166: the history tour uses deadlineAfterSec 4 and showAfterSec 8; at ~1 s per transaction the proposals and acceptances alone take longer, so `--history` (used in README's devnet command) will likely cancel every show and leave the track record at 0; not exercised by any recorded run
packages/agents/src/planner.ts:168: a city with no free day is dropped with no backfill from the next-ranked city, so the tour can end up short of wantedShows

packages/agents/src/fan-sim.ts:106-108: run 2026-10-08T20-06-17-837Z transcript id 268 still leaks "purchase failed: Unknown action 'undefined'" (an Anchor client error) into the feed; map unknown client errors to a readable note
packages/agents/src/venue-agent.ts:137-138: dynamic `await import('@solana/web3.js')` for PublicKey although it is a direct dependency

packages/agents/src/orchestrator.ts:242: the accept/reject wait is a fixed 40 x 500 ms poll; a slow venue transaction is silently treated as undecided and the show is dropped from `live` (correct, but not reported in the feed)
